title: OPSUCHT Mining
description: A mining texturepack made for OPSUCHT.net
body:
A clean and minimalist texture pack designed specifically for OPSUCHT. It helps making the importan blocks more visible and gets rid off the ugly deepslate design.

**Changed Blocks**: Deepslate, Tuff, Gravel, and all Deepslate Ore variants.

Ingame Screenshots: [#Gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/opsucht-mining/gallery)
